## Public working papers {#public-working-papers}
:::

::: {.publication-list}

::: {.publication-item}
<div class="pub-year">2026</div>
<div class="pub-body">

### Negative Time Preference & the Czech Sugar Industry from 1896 to 1926

**Jiří Rytina and Adam Dittrich**  
HAL Open Science working paper, hal-05660879.

The paper reconstructs how industrial actors understood long-horizon sacrifice, social provision, and institutional responsibility across the late Habsburg and early Czechoslovak periods.

[HAL record](https://hal.science/hal-05660879){.pill-link}
[RePEc record](https://ideas.repec.org/p/hal/wpaper/hal-05660879.html){.pill-link}
</div>

## Research papers with open data {#research-papers-with-open-data}
:::

::: {.publication-list}

::: {.publication-item}
<div class="pub-year">Research</div>
<div class="pub-body">

### Measuring Financial Stress under the Gold Standard: Evidence from Interwar Czechoslovakia

**Adam Dittrich**

A monthly composite index uses eleven financial and macro-financial indicators to recover the chronology of pressure from November 1929 to September 1938. The project connects statistical measurement to the institutional mechanics of the Czechoslovak gold-standard regime.

[Data and documentation](https://www.openicpsr.org/openicpsr/project/247312/version/V1/view){.pill-link}
[Project summary](data.qmd#financial-stress-under-the-gold-standard){.pill-link}
</div>
:::

## Projects in development {#projects-in-development}
:::

::: {.wip-grid}

::: {.wip-card}
<span class="wip-field">Working paper · Monetary history</span>

### Gold Flows, Sterilisation, and the Monetary Base in Interwar Czechoslovakia, 1927–1938

Reserve movements, domestic balance-sheet operations, and changes in the monetary regime after devaluation.
:::

::: {.wip-card}
<span class="wip-field">Project in development · Central banking</span>

### From Bills to Money Markets: The Structural Transformation of the Credit Transmission Mechanism of the National Bank of Czechoslovakia, 1926–1936

Central-bank credit, the commercial-bill channel, and liquidity management.
:::

::: {.wip-card}
<span class="wip-field">Working paper · History of economic thought</span>

### Crisis as a Failure of Distribution: Jan Loevenstein’s Theory of Underconsumption, Technological Unemployment, and the Great Depression

A study of Loevenstein’s account of crisis, distribution, and unemployment.
:::

::: {.wip-card}
<span class="wip-field">Historical national accounts</span>

### Reconstructing Interwar Czechoslovak Output

The Czechoslovak contribution to comparative work on Central and Eastern European historical GDP with Matthias Morys and Marcin Wroński. Current work focuses on agricultural output and value added, sectoral coverage, prices, intermediate inputs, and comparability across countries.
:::
